semantic_reuse.use: The root-to-legal-return-witness relation is observed by return length; its powerset-valued image is the canonical support-valued return signature.
semantic_reuse.boundary: Powerset support deliberately forgets multiplicity. The multiplicity refinement below is task-local and is not promoted as a new global tool family.

native_return_definitions.primitive_return: An undirected simple native cycle through root x, viewed as a simple nonbacktracking first return to x, with orientation and basepoint quotienting.
native_return_definitions.support_signature: Sigma_X(x) = {k : there exists a primitive return of length k through x}.
native_return_definitions.multiplicity_signature: mu_X(x,k) = number of unoriented primitive returns of length k through x.
native_return_definitions.anonymous_support_packet: multiset over roots x of Sigma_X(x).
native_return_definitions.anonymous_multiplicity_packet: multiset over roots x of the finite count profile k -> mu_X(x,k).

smallest_branching_core.definition: Connected finite simple native-Cell graphs on exactly four Cells, minimum degree at least two, maximum degree at most three, and at least one degree-three Cell; local axis/carrier/PF-10 decorations are uniform.
smallest_branching_core.minimality_reason: A degree-three Cell requires at least four vertices in a finite simple graph.

degree_controlled_cubic_witness.claim: Set-valued return support remains noninjective even after every Cell has native degree three.

separating_multiplicity.consequence: The graphs are nonisomorphic and their anonymous multiplicity packets differ.

terminal_classification.disposition: The degree-two scalar period does not extend as a class-level single-valued coordinate.
